worldcombat.skill.copycat.summary: Pick up the last move used anywhere on the field and perform it again; it fails if no move has been used yet.
worldcombat.skill.copycat.use.0: Throw a foe's heavy attack right back
worldcombat.skill.copycat.use.1: Copy an ally's buff or setup
worldcombat.skill.copycat.use.2: Chain onto the move someone just teed up
worldcombat.skill.copycat.description.0: The borrowed move reaches up to %1$s blocks; only moves used within %2$s are remembered.
worldcombat.skill.copycat.description.2: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.copycat.deep.on: Deep echo: a longer memory window and denser echoes, but a slower windup and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.copycat.deep.off: Shallow echo: quick and cheap, but it only catches the sound that just rang.
worldcombat.skill.copycat.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.copycat.preference.dee: On: memory window ×1.6 and denser echoes, catching older moves, but windup +3 ticks and cooldown ×1.35; off: a quick grab at the sound that just rang.
When the borrowed move needs an enemy, the AI will not echo beyond this distance; smaller echoes only up close.
When on, the user may leave its post to echo; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
world_combat.move.copycat.text.empty: No sound on the field yet
